Displays the list of types of time off leaves in the system.

The filter with salary payment (with_pay) is optional.


**Permisos requeridos para utilizar este endpoint:** 
* Attendance permissions en: 'Lectura' o 'Lectura y Modificación'.

Creates a type of time off in the system.

A LicenceType object must be sent as a JSON object in the
the body of the request, composed of the following attributes:
 - code: Unique code that identifies the time off
 - name: Name of type of time off
 - description: Description of type of time off
 with_pay: whether it includes salary payment or not (optional, by default is false)
 requestable: whether the type of time off can be requested by the Colaborador (optional, by default is false)
